links.outcome: Citation/source verification of RAG-grounded LLM diagnostic outputs across pipelines
links.effect: Open-source models showed markedly superior sourcing versus GPT-4-based combinations (P < 1.4e-12); MBXAI/Qwen2 pipeline achieved perfect citation verification.
links.quote: Open-source models demonstrated markedly superior sourcing capabilities compared to GPT-4-based combinations (P < 1.4e-12), with MBXAI/Qwen2 pipeline achieving perfect citation verification.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM pipelines with retrieval-augmented generation on 79 real-world emergency department cases. Does not evaluate an intervention comparing outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
